rows.en: Understood… Let's go, Hayato, [HERO4]!!
What a lousy job… Chasing after Shocker's top executive!
"Don't hold it against me, [HERO2]. Just like you said… the coin's tails on both sides."
"Don't hold it against me, [HERO2]. Just like you said… the coin's heads on both sides."

Well, well… That's Shocker for you. Arriving right on time…

All right, shall we go?
Yes…
What was that scream just now?
Damn… Is it Shocker!? Taki, I'm leaving this to you!
All right…
…!? A Shocker cyborg?

Hoooowww…

Takeshi Hongo! Now that you've come here, it's clear where Dr. Otaguro is. You people are hiding him, aren't you?

What if we are?

Hand over Yoshiko and get out of my sight! It's for your own good.
Waaaaagh…
Hongo! Hongo!!
Ugh… I lost… He beat me completely…
Ugh, Shocker has her… I'm sorry, I couldn't save her!
He's a terrifying opponent…
Oyassan, I'm sorry. And I was right there with him…
So… how's Takeshi doing?
He's resting in the back… but he needs complete bed rest for a while.
I see…

Everyone, I'm sorry. It's only because I'm here that you're having all this trouble…

I should never have come here for help after all.

No, don't say that…

So, Hayato… how about you? Did you find anything?

The Shocker top executive who came to Japan brought a huge load of explosives from the Swiss Branch!

[HERO2] and I blew up most of it, but I can't say we got it all. And also… he'd brought in some frozen corpses.
Corpses? For what purpose?
I don't know…

Oh, how terrible!

No doubt Yoshiko is suffering horribly in Shocker's hideout by now. And the X-Alpha Solution research materials, most likely…
What!?
Hayato, what did Colonel Zol say?

He means to settle things with us fair and square. He told us to come to Jigokudani, and Yoshiko's there too… …!?

Jigokudani?

That's it! Now I see it! What Shocker is plotting with Operation World Darkness!

Jigokudani has a power plant. A million-volt output, supplying electricity to more than ten major cities!

Shocker means to build revived monsters with the X-Alpha Solution, destroy similar power plants all over the world one after another, and use the chaos to carry out world conquest!

That's why the Shocker top executive who came to Japan brought a huge load of explosives from the Swiss Branch!

Most likely, they'll blow up Yoshiko along with the power plant…
I see… That's just the kind of thing they'd come up with!
Hayato, let's go! Let's avenge Mr. Hongo and rescue Yoshiko!
Ooh, that line just now… sounded kinda like a hero.
Come on, you… Now of all times?
No, [HERO4]'s right! That's our mission! A mission where we're not allowed to fail, not even once.
Ah… yes!
Oyassan… Take care of Hongo! All right, let's go.
My, they've all grown into fine people…
Takeshi! You can't be up, you need to lie down!
Oyassan, where's Hayato?

They've all gone to Jigokudani!

Takeshi, wait! You can't in that condition! Leave it to Hayato and the others!

That's right…

You've already fought more than enough for Yoshiko and me. No more…
Let me go!
You idiot!! Think about your body!

Oyassan…

Let me go! Oyassan!!
Takeshi…
Colonel Zol! Come out! I won't let you destroy the power plant!

Heh heh heh… So you've shown up? You seem to have seen through Operation World Darkness… but it's too late!

I'll blow you all away with it! Demolition team, flip the switch!
Eeee!

Hold it!

Hayato, leave this end to me! I won't let them flip that switch even if it kills me.

Grr… The FBI dog, Kazuya Taki, yet again?

My brothers… Listen carefully!

All who stand in the way of us who seek world conquest are enemies, and taking their lives is the mission you, the chosen ones, were made for!

Don't let a single one leave alive! Go!
What's that!? The cyborgs we've beaten before?
Surprised? The X-Alpha Solution is in the hands of our Shocker scientists! Creating revived monsters is a simple matter.
Hongo!? And [HERO2], [HERO4]!
We'll fight too! If we die, we all die together.

Hongo…

All right, let's go!
Hongo!?
I'll fight too! If we die, we all die together.

Heh heh heh heh…

Our Shocker scientists have not only revived monsters, but mass-produced cyborg clones already at the practical stage!!

Splendid, up to this point! Enemy though you are, I commend you…

But the real contest starts now! Just as you can transform, so too shall I transform…

I'll show you my true form! Waooooowww…
What!? Colonel Zol is a cyborg too!?
What!? Colonel Zol is a cyborg too!?
What did you say!? Colonel Zol is a cyborg too!?
What did you say!? Colonel Zol is a cyborg too!?
Waooooowww…
Taki! Looks like the power plant's been secured! I'm counting on you to save Yoshiko!
Taki! Looks like the power plant's been secured! I'm counting on you to save Yoshiko!
Taki! Looks like the power plant's been secured! I'm counting on you to save Yoshiko!
Taki! Looks like the power plant's been secured! I'm counting on you to save Yoshiko!
Got it! Leave it to me!
All right… Looks like our side's secured the power plant! Let's rescue Yoshiko!
I don't know how to thank you enough…
Truly…

No… We're the ones who learned something!

Just how much strength trust and love can bring out…
Only part of the power plant got destroyed, too. I'm glad it came through okay.

But… we can't just celebrate!

Shocker already has a new top executive. What kind of guy is he… and what kind of attack will he launch?

Nah… With you lot around, no matter who shows up, it'll be no big deal, right?

And also… Dr. Otaguro says he'll join the TDF's science group.
I don't know whether someone like me can be of any use, but I'll give it my best, at any rate…
I'm truly so glad…

U01179: 死命 read as 使命 (mission)

U01204: assumed the new top executive (Doctor Death) is male, as glossary/series establish
